extracted text: The specimens and coupons were manufactured from the same 13.5 mm thick extruded aluminum alloy 6061-T6 plate. The average mechanical properties obtained from the 3 coupon tests and chemical composition of the material is given in Table 1. The average yield strength is 257 MPa and the tensile strength is 300 MPa, which indicates a yield-to-tensile strength ratio of 0.86. The gage length of the coupon test is 50 mm, and the average elongation is 12%, which is around half of that of mild steel.
